values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica price block on the dated site page(s) (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

booking.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-forests/find-a-forest/loyalsock/camping ('may be reserved up to eleven months in advance'; 'Stays are limited to seven nights'; 'Check in and check out time is 3:00 P.M. Campers must vacate for at least 48 hours before returning.'); https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/motorized-roadside-camping ('Most campsites in Pennsylvania state forests can be reserved 11 months in advance to noon of the day of arrival'; 'A camping permit will be valid for no more than seven consecutive nights'); site page(s) 23750, 23688 ('Site Reserve Type: Site-Specific', 'Checkin Time: 3:00 pm', 'Checkout Time: 3:00 pm', 'Max Reservation Window: Sun Oct 10 2027'); read 2026-11-10. Calendars queried for 14 nights from each of 2026-11-17, 2027-05-12 and 2027-07-14: 456 'Not Available' on every night in November 2026 and July 2027 and Available or Reserved in May 2027; 475 the reverse. This is the forest's stated even/odd resting rotation, not an unexplained closure. No 'Walkup Only' label on any page.

note: Two separate sites in the woods above Mill Creek, reached from PA 87 near Hillsgrove by Mill Creek Road (3.9 miles) and Walker Road: 456 is 1.4 miles along Walker Road, a short gravel back-in; 475 is a mile farther and then 1.4 miles down Camel Road, with a grass driveway about 60 ft long. The agency says the site was not designed for RVs. Its campsite map layer calls 456 tent-only with no trailer access, though the booking page sells it as an RV and trailer site (29 by 25 ft); 475 is listed as 40 by 18 ft. No toilet. Pack out trash. --Claude
